title: De novo biosynthesis of the meroterpenoid grifolic acid in Yarrowia lipolytica
summary: Engineered Yarrowia lipolytica produced grifolic acid de novo at 30.5 mg/L in shaker-flask fed-batch culture, after orsellinic acid accumulation was raised to 8.50 mg/L. AI-guided molecular docking and deep-learning kinetic predictors (CataPro and UniKP) were used to screen candidate enzymes and identify the prenyltransferase StbC from Stachybotrys bisbyi. AI is one step among several engineering steps (precursor supply, efflux pumps, pathway blocking), and the titer is at flask scale.
ai_technology: Docking and deep-learning kinetic predictors (CataPro, UniKP) used to screen prenyltransferase candidates
organization: Technion-Israel Institute of Technology; Cancer Hospital of Shantou University Medical College; Guangdong Technion-Israel Institute of Technology

evidence.tested: Strain construction and fed-batch fermentation measured grifolic acid at 30.5 mg/L.
evidence.unknown: Scale-up beyond shaker flasks; how much the AI screening contributed relative to other engineering steps; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning kinetic prediction and AI-guided docking selected the prenyltransferase StbC.
